// error codes

You followed a link the compiler printed.

Every Jet diagnostic carries a code and links here. Each code has a generated page with the registered What, Why, Fix, and its first UI snapshot example. See the E0112 page. The same explanation is available offline, instantly, from the toolchain you already have.

$ jet explain E0112

Explanations look like this one, which is real:

Error [E0112]: `plan` wants Int (a whole number) for argument 2, but this is String (text) --> broken.jet:4:26 | 4 | print(plan("Lisbon", "three")) | ^^^^^^^ Why: every argument must match its parameter's type Fix: use Int (a whole number) here More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

If an explanation is wrong or unhelpful, that is a bug in Jet, and reporting it is a contribution.
